items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: He was the suitcase man with such swing cats as the late Bix Beiderbecke, Miff Moll and Frank Trumbauer.

ctx.x: Leo Condilli, trumpet. Miff Moll, trombone; Dudley Fosdick, mellophone; Fud Livingston, clarinet; tenor; Art Miller, string bass. Chauncey Morehouse, drums, vibes, sometimes solo.
Do you remember Manny Klein? He's still playing. I think he's still around, isn't he.
